public_rationale: On the ordinary functional reading, AI21 and Cohere both offered general-purpose language generation and related text capabilities in 2021, well before ChatGPT launched in November 2022. That supports the existence of multiple companies doing the same kind of work as GPT-3. It does not establish identical performance or equivalent consumer products. The result therefore depends on the stated reading of “exactly.”
limitations: Functional availability is documented mainly by company disclosures.
Strict equivalence across benchmarks is not established.
The sources do not establish the surrounding claim about why ChatGPT became popular.

statement.excerpt: There were multiple other companies doing exactly what GPT-3 did months before ChatGPT launched.

our_interpretation: Multiple means at least two companies other than OpenAI.
The plain functional reading is general-purpose language generation and related text tasks through a language model, rather than identical outputs or identical scores on every benchmark.
The comparison is explicitly with GPT-3, not with every feature of ChatGPT.
I use June 2020 through September 2022 as the historical comparison window, ending at least two months before ChatGPT's November 2022 launch.
The temporal comparison is not a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Dated primary records establish that at least two other companies offered comparable general-purpose language-model functionality within the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Historical product records establish that fewer than two other companies offered comparable functionality before the cutoff.

evidence.explanation: The announcement offers Jurassic-1 through an open-beta API and web environment and describes text generation, question answering, and classification. It establishes one other company's comparable functional offering well before the cutoff.

The disclosure describes customers accessing and customizing Cohere's language models through an API. This establishes a second company offering comparable text-generation functionality before the cutoff.

The original paper establishes GPT-3's general language-generation functionality and describes other prompted language tasks. It supplies the comparison baseline, not evidence of another company's offering.

The dated announcement establishes the launch used for the temporal comparison. Its conversational framing also explains why the existence of earlier language-model APIs does not establish identical consumer products.
